title: Electrum Energized
description: Changes the textures of electrum in Create: Crafts & Additions to make it look less like gold.
body:
I really didn't like the default textures for electrum in C&A because it looked too much like gold and not it's own unique resource. In this pack i've made electrum more piss yellow to make it stand out and gave the items an outline to reflect the conductive properties of this material.

Create: Crafts & Additions: https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition

Check out my mod to make electrum less grindy: https://modrinth.com/mod/catch-the-lightning
